from pathlib import Path
import json,os,subprocess,time
from collect_phase_g23_records import sha,write_identical
root=Path.cwd(); base=root/'results/phase_g/g3/v1/validation_branch'
launch=json.loads((base/'LAUNCH.json').read_text()); results=[]
for index,(name,argv) in enumerate(launch['commands']):
 start=time.monotonic(); started=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')
 logfile=base/f'{index:02d}_{name}.log'
 with logfile.open('xb') as log:
  outcome=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=False)
  log.flush(); os.fsync(log.fileno())
 record={'command':argv,'name':name,'returncode':outcome.returncode,'started':started,'ended':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z'),'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'log':str(logfile.relative_to(root)),'log_sha256':sha(logfile)}
 write_identical(base/f'{index:02d}_{name}.json',(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n').encode()); results.append(record)
 if outcome.returncode!=0: break
summary={'source_head':launch['source_head'],'worker_source_sha256':launch['worker_source_sha256'],'results':results,'all_commands_passed':len(results)==len(launch['commands']) and all(r['returncode']==0 for r in results),'time':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')}
write_identical(base/'EXIT.json',(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
raise SystemExit(0 if summary['all_commands_passed'] else 1)
